paragraphs.content: Masaryk University soon organized the first workshop for teachers, followed by a webinar, which introduced the main principles of generative AI, presented the most relevant applications, and discussed ethical issues related to generative AI. It also offered a space for experiences sharing and learning from each others' examples of good practice. A couple of months later, Masaryk University published another document - Recommendations on the use of artificial intelligence tools in fulfilling study requirements. The publication of ChatGPT in November 2022 caused various reactions amongst academic communities around the world. Whereas some institutions already had dedicated working groups working on policies and guidelines, some institutions were surprised by the pace of recent developments in the area of generative artificial intelligence. It became clear very soon that ChatGPT would change education fundamentally. Some institutions tried to prevent this change by forbidding ChatGPT on their campuses but quickly recognized that this kind of effort was futile. On the other hand, the institutions handled the issue proactively and encouraged their teachers to incorporate AI tools into their teaching (Dubljević 2024).
